title: The truancy program’s completion rate rose after the hours required fell

beats.text: A San Francisco truancy program reported a rise in completion.

visual.sub: The participation threshold changed between school years

beats.text: In the first school year, thirty percent reached fifteen hours.

visual.label: The participation threshold changed between school years

beats.text: The next year, ninety-five percent reached five hours.

visual.label: The participation threshold changed between school years

beats.text: Those percentages measure different amounts of service.
The first report lacked a participant count against the target.

visual.kicker: A later report supplied missing participation totals

beats.text: Two weeks later, a revised report put participation at 133 percent of target.

visual.label: A later report supplied missing participation totals

beats.text: The department did not track whether students missed fewer days of school.
For renewal, the school-year threshold changed again to ten hours.

visual.label: The renewal introduced another service threshold

beats.text: The department said that goal reflected its experience during the pandemic.

visual.kicker: The renewal introduced another service threshold

beats.text: The Board approved an increase of 606,040 dollars.

visual.label: The grant ceiling and payments cover different periods

beats.text: The fiscal review found no issues.
The question is how much school attendance changed for the students served.
